sections.name: bugs
sections.label: Bugs filed
sections.content: srs-rust#1711: archive pack and slice export drop protocol runs. srs-rust#1712: protocol run advance accepts an unknown stage and ignores dependsOn. srs-rust#1713: date and date-time values are not validated. srs-rust#1714: blueprint brief describes only the root type.

sections.name: gaps
sections.label: Gaps
sections.content: The nine things in part 2. Also: blueprint schema models a star around the root; the spec defines no ProtocolRun and no place for runs in the repository layout; a composition cannot number its items; a relation row cannot filter by the type at the other end and prints only the related record's identity; list payloads name ids and relation ends differently from get and create; a write accepts a tag that validation then rejects; each stage raises its own open questions with nothing to stop repeats.

sections.name: worked
sections.label: What worked with no change
sections.content: Package bundles and installation; a slice that carries its package; Protocol to Blueprint linking and validation; closed vocabularies enforced on write; compositions with relation rows; tombstones; createdBy stamping per stage.
